description: Canonical decode performance workloads. MoE routing depends on the token stream, so MoE performance evidence must come from distinct prompts sampled at temperature 1; DSA models additionally need rows on both sides of index_topk. scripts/decode_run.py enforces these profiles at record time and scripts/compare_decode_runs.py refuses MoE records without canonical evidence.

glm-dsa-diverse-v1.description: Single-batch GLM-5.x decode workload with rows on both sides of the DSA index_topk boundary: S stays at or below it for the whole run, X crosses it during decode, L starts above it.
glm-dsa-diverse-v1.capacity_note: Bands and weights keep G512 (64 rows/rank) admissible at once with ~10% page margin on the 2026-10-08 H200 engine (2982 pages/rank, admission fraction 0.9); G1024 is not a fixed-shape point.

glm-dsa-diverse-v2.description: glm-dsa-diverse-v1 with a row sampling form both BatchGen and SGLang accept: top_k omitted (disabled in both engines; SGLang rejects top_k=0), temperature 1.0 / top_p 1.0, and the thinking switch both as top-level enable_thinking (BatchGen) and chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking (SGLang). Same strata, bands, sources and selection as v1, so the prompts are identical row for row.
glm-dsa-diverse-v2.capacity_note: Bands and weights keep G512 (64 rows/rank) admissible at once with ~10% page margin on the 2026-10-08 H200 engine (2982 pages/rank, admission fraction 0.9); G1024 is not a fixed-shape point.

k3-diverse-v1.description: Matched-concurrency single-batch workload of the Kimi-K3 4-node H20 decode campaign: a realistic eval mix of distinct prompts sampled at temperature 1, in the cross-engine row form of glm-dsa-diverse-v2 (top_k omitted; thinking both as top-level enable_thinking for BatchGen and chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking for SGLang). K3 is hybrid KDA+MLA with no DSA, so the S/X/L strata carry no index_topk boundary semantics; their bands and weights are kept identical to glm-dsa-diverse-v1 for cross-campaign comparability.
k3-diverse-v1.capacity_note: Target G512. Admission numbers for the K3 H20 engine (per-rank GPU KV pages, world size) are TBD and must be passed at build time via --gpu-pool-pages/--world-size; the build refuses a workload that cannot be admitted at once.

glm-dsa-diverse-short-v1.description: Supplementary GLM-5.x cell: every row stays at or below index_topk for the whole run, so the all-short attention path is exercised. Never a substitute for glm-dsa-diverse-v1.

glm-dsa-diverse-short-v2.description: glm-dsa-diverse-short-v1 with the v2 cross-engine row sampling form (see glm-dsa-diverse-v2). Never a substitute for glm-dsa-diverse-v2.

moe-diverse-v1.description: Single-batch decode workload for MoE models without DSA: distinct MMLU-Pro prompts sampled at temperature 1.

moe-matrix-exact-ctx-v1.description: run_test.sh wave-matrix lane for MoE models: distinct MMLU-Pro rows padded to one exact prompt length per cell, sampled at temperature 1. For DSA models run_decode_matrix.sh requires context cells on both sides of index_topk.

forest-v1.description: GPT-OSS prefix-reuse workload W3: a prefix forest with high prefix variance (6 application families with shared system prompts, 79 shared documents, multi-turn threads, edited variants, private attachments, 8% cold requests; interleaved order that keeps turns in order).
forest-v1.digest_note: The source plan records only the truncated prefix a69442be... of the forest.jsonl SHA-256, and no file on branch tairan/prefix-kv-integrity-stress records the full value. The full digest is the inputs.forest.sha256 field of the manifest.json that scripts/prefix_reuse_forest_workload.py writes beside forest.jsonl in the w3_forest_v1 artifact directory; copy it from that manifest, or from sha256 of the artifact's forest.jsonl, and confirm it starts with a69442be.

generator.corpus: 1,206 BatchGen source and doc files at BatchGen 91c06026, special-token text escaped

request_parameters.source: body() and KINDS in scripts/prefix_reuse_forest_workload.py at the generator commit

k3-diverse-v1c.description: Completions-format twin of k3-diverse-v1: identical selection seed, strata, sampling and content; the chat template (enable_thinking=true) is pre-rendered to prompt text by the BatchGen tokenizer so a foreign engine tokenizes exactly the predicted prompt tokens. Row-for-row token-identical to k3-diverse-v1.
k3-diverse-v1c.capacity_note: Target G512. Admission numbers for the K3 H20 engine (per-rank GPU KV pages, world size) are TBD and must be passed at build time via --gpu-pool-pages/--world-size; the build refuses a workload that cannot be admitted at once.

k3-diverse-e2e-v1.description: k3-diverse-v1 as an end-to-end batch workload: the same strata, sources, sampling and cross-engine row form, but natural stopping (no ignore_eos) with an 8192-token completion cap, 2048 distinct prompts.
k3-diverse-e2e-v1.capacity_note: Target G2048 on the 4x8 H20 engine (20000 pages/rank, admission 0.9): 64 rows/rank at <= ceil((2600+8192)/64)=169 pages each stays under the 18000-page cap, so the batch is admissible at once.

glm-dsa-e2e-v1.description: glm-dsa-diverse-v2 as an end-to-end batch workload: natural stopping (no ignore_eos) with an 8192-token completion cap, 2048 distinct prompts; on one 8xH200 node the batch is oversubscribed by design and runs in waves, so runs of this profile are end-to-end rows, not fixed-shape decode rows.
glm-dsa-e2e-v1.capacity_note: G2048 on one 8xH200 node (2982 pages/rank) is deliberately oversubscribed: build with --allow-oversubscribed; the engine admits in waves and the measured quantity is batch completion time.

glm-long-e2e-v1.description: Long-context fixed-length stress: longbench documents at 6000-8000 prompt tokens with ignore_eos and a fixed 4096-token completion, 512 distinct prompts. Every row decodes the full 4096 tokens, so decode runs at the GPU-KV-pool-bound concurrency for the whole run with no EOS drain tail; the measured quantities are batch completion time and sustained decode throughput at a large per-row KV footprint.
glm-long-e2e-v1.capacity_note: 512 rows x (~7k prompt + 4096 completion) ~= 5.7M KV tokens; a 50 GiB/rank unified pool holds ~0.6M tokens, so the run is ~10x oversubscribed and admits in pool-bound waves: build with --allow-oversubscribed.

lcb-fixed4096-v1.description: LiveCodeBench medium and hard competitive-programming prompts at natural length, ignore_eos with a fixed 4096-token completion, 512 distinct problems. Shared by GLM-5.3 and Kimi-K3 and by the SGLang arm. Natural completion length is measured by a separate pilot, not assumed.
lcb-fixed4096-v1.capacity_note: Oversubscribes the GPU KV pool on one 8xH200 node: build with --allow-oversubscribed.

nqa64k-grouped-v1.description: Document-grouped long-prefix batch: 64 distinct NarrativeQA books truncated to a 64k-token shared prefix, 8 questions per book (512 rows). Distinct groups share distinct prefixes (RAG/doc-QA shape). EOS honoured with a 4096-token cap, thinking on; decided with the release owner 2026-11-03 (forced decode rejected to avoid post-EOS gibberish steering expert routing).
nqa64k-grouped-v1.capacity_note: Massively oversubscribes the GPU KV pool (512 x ~64.1k prompt tokens); host-KV streaming and prefix reuse are the mechanisms under test: build with --allow-oversubscribed.

nqa64k-distinct-v1.description: Distinct-document pure long-prefill batch: 312 distinct NarrativeQA books (train and test splits pooled, one row per book) each truncated to a 64k-token prefix with one question (312 rows; the train+test pool holds 389 books that survive a 260k-char pre-filter and 317 that still reach 64k tokens under the GLM tokenizer). Cross-sequence prefix reuse is ~0.1% by construction (only the shared chat-template header), so the workload measures raw long-context prefill and oversubscribed decode without any reuse mechanism in play. Controlled A/B twin of nqa64k-grouped-v1: ~20.0M total prompt tokens, same sampling and EOS contract; the only variable is the reuse structure.
nqa64k-distinct-v1.capacity_note: Massively oversubscribes the GPU KV pool (312 x ~64.1k prompt tokens) with no cross-row prefix sharing available; host-KV streaming and prefill scheduling are the mechanisms under test: build with --allow-oversubscribed.

pending_profiles_comment: Prefix-reuse family profiles not registered yet: controlled prefix-tree, long-tail, re-entry.
